verdict.rationale: The product is a set of agent skills that are driven conversationally. Each SKILL.md declares natural-language triggers (e.g. "Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions 'red-green-refactor'"), and skills like grilling run as natural-language interviews with the user. Slash commands are the headline invocation path alongside this. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration that natural-language triggering works (the runtime probe only verifies installation), and explicit first-party documentation of natural-language invocation as a primary mode rather than slash commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.
